decks.notes: The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to utilize a variety of instant spells and card draw effects to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw, allowing the player to efficiently deal with threats and maintain card advantage. The deck also includes powerful threats like Crackling Drake to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Overall, the key strategy is to outvalue the opponent through efficient card selection and powerful spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to continuously tutor for powerful creatures and disrupt opponent's strategies. It aims to control the board through a combination of removal spells like Chained to the Rocks and interaction with cards like Fires of Invention. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value through flickering permanents and generating card advantage. The deck includes a mix of value creatures, powerful threats, and disruptive elements to outvalue opponents and control the game. The mana base is built around fetching the necessary colors to support the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combination of Greasefang Parhelion and other cards to create a powerful and consistent strategy. It includes a mix of disruption, card selection, and recursion to set up the combo and protect it once it's in play. The deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces while controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's game plan. By efficiently using its resources and synergies, the deck can overwhelm opponents and secure victories through its unique combo interactions.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing powerful creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. With efficient removal options like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill, along with disruptive hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a threatening board presence. Cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester help deal damage and close out games, while resilient threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide a powerful late-game option. This deck aims to win through swift and relentless aggression.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive tempo plays with evasive spirit creatures in order to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By leveraging cards like Rattlechains and Spell Queller to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect your own creatures, while also utilizing Curious Obsession for card advantage and additional pressure, you can maintain control of the board while pushing through damage. The inclusion of cards like Shacklegeist and Lofty Denial also help to disrupt the opponent's plays, while cards like Spectral Sailor and Mutavault provide additional versatility and potential threats. By balancing aggression with disruption, you can outmaneuver and defeat your opponents efficiently.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to effectively control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By using cards like Spell Pierce, Fiery Impulse, and Blitz of the Thunder-Raptor, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while drawing cards with Treasure Cruise and Consider. The deck also includes a win condition in Crackling Drake, which benefits from the deck's focus on instants and sorceries. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, allowing the deck to respond to various threats effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly with mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to play powerful green creatures and Planeswalkers. The deck utilizes cards with devotion to green to maximize mana production and take advantage of Nykthos' ability. With an aggressive playstyle, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn while using Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator for additional value and disruption. Storm the Festival helps to find key cards while also providing a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize green mana acceleration and devotion to power out powerful green creatures and spells quickly. By ramping up with Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck can quickly cast threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. Oath of Nissa and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner help dig for key pieces, while Karn, the Great Creator offers utility and disruption. Storm the Festival acts as card advantage, and Lair of the Hydra can be a powerful finisher alongside Cityscape Leveler.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through sacrificing creatures for value and dealing incremental damage. The synergy between cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, Witch's Oven, and Claim the Firstborn allows for efficient removal and constant damage output. By utilizing sacrifice effects and recursion, the deck aims to control the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a useful companion that provides additional mana acceleration and flexibility to the deck's gameplay.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a strong Rakdos color identity. It includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand while using efficient removal like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill to deal with threats. The deck also has powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Graveyard Trespasser, and Bloodtithe Harvester to pressure the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse allows for additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence through low-cost creatures and efficient mana sources. It utilizes companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional consistency and flexibility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures such as Thraben Inspector, Venerated Loxodon, and Regal Leosaur, while also providing disruption with cards like Giant Killer and Resolute Reinforcements. The addition of burn spells like Gleeful Demolition adds reach and versatility. Overall, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, to power out powerful green creatures and planeswalkers. The deck focuses on devotion to green to maximize the effectiveness of Nykthos and other cards like Wolfwillow Haven. It also includes spells like Storm the Festival to find more creatures and Cityscape Leveler to create a massive threat. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and powerful abilities while maintaining a high level of aggression.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control of the board with a mix of Spirit creatures and instants while applying pressure to the opponent. By utilizing efficient creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller alongside disruption spells such as Lofty Denial and Geistlight Snare, the deck aims to establish a quick tempo advantage and protect its key threats. Curious Obsession provides card advantage and additional pressure, while the land base supports the aggressive strategy by providing consistent mana sources. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive yet resilient spirit creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to play Lotus Field and generate a large amount of mana, while using combo pieces like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field multiple times in one turn. The deck aims to cast Omniscience and other powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum to overwhelm the opponent in a single turn. It also includes cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Boseiju, Who Endures for additional resilience and protection. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to win the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. Using cheap spells like Opt and Consider, you can dig through your deck to find the necessary pieces to enable the Phoenix's return. Additionally, cards like Thing in the Ice can provide a threatening board presence and Temporal Trespass can offer a powerful finisher. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional win conditions if the Phoenix plan is disrupted.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Dreadbore to control the board while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes cards that provide value and card advantage, such as Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Castle Locthwain. With a mix of removal spells, efficient creatures, and powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil, this deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain control throughout the game.
